retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome layout featuring a lone figure in a vast landscape topped by large-scale, stencil-cut serif typography.
triggerTerms: black and white country album style
desolate landscape photography with centered text
excludeWhen: busy urban environments are the subject

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition divided into a top half of negative space containing large, high-contrast stencil-cut serif text and a bottom half featuring a grainy, black-and-white photograph of a man in a cowboy hat standing in a flat, desolate landscape.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy typographic hierarchy against a clear sky
Horizontal division between sky and ground at the vertical center
Lone human figure as a vertical anchor in the lower right quadrant
Geometric border detail framing the top edge
coreInvariants: Stencil-cut vertical gaps in the serif letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-full shot of a man, positioned in the lower right, occupying approximately one-third of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large-scale title text at the top center acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold top text, moves down the central axis to the artist name, and finally rests on the figure in the landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper half (sky) provides a clean canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the landscape and sky
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the typography and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for highlights and paper-like background
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the black text and the light gray sky.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
Vertical stencil cuts through the thickest parts of the stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'A' feature distinct vertical breaks in their primary strokes
The 'S' is constructed with disconnected curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same stencil-serif family separated by thin horizontal rules.
graphicDevices: Geometric patterned border at the top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast modern serif skeleton with stencil attributes.
Provides a similar stencil-cut elegance in a serif form.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, black and white photograph of a man in a cowboy hat and flannel shirt standing in a flat, dusty desert landscape under a vast, clear gray sky. The horizon line should be at the vertical center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, black stencil-cut serif text in the upper half of the image. Use thin horizontal lines to separate the title from the artist name.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Does the text have vertical stencil gaps?
Is there a thin geometric border at the very top?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the top border pattern
mustRedesign: Centered figure (must be slightly off-center for this specific balance)

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Check that the stencil cuts are vertically aligned.
Ensure the text does not overlap the horizon line.
Verify the figure's hat is clearly defined against the sky.
Confirm the top border is subtle and does not distract from the title.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast stencil serif + centered sky placement + grainy B&W landscape photography.
